entries.title: Psalms 83:1
segments: ¶<<A Song. A Psalm of Asaph.>> Do not keep silent, O God! Do not hold Your peace, And do not be still, O God!

entries.title: Psalms 83:2
segments: For behold, Your enemies make a tumult; And those who hate You have lifted up their head.

entries.title: Psalms 83:3
segments: They have taken crafty counsel against Your people, And consulted together against Your sheltered ones.

entries.title: Psalms 83:4
segments: They have said, "Come, and let us cut them off from [being] a nation, That the name of Israel may be remembered no more."

entries.title: Psalms 83:5
segments: For they have consulted together with one consent; They form a confederacy against You:

entries.title: Psalms 83:6
segments: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab and the Hagrites;

entries.title: Psalms 83:7
segments: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;

entries.title: Psalms 83:8
segments: Assyria also has joined with them; They have helped the children of Lot. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 83:9
segments: ¶Deal with them as [with] Midian, As [with] Sisera, As [with] Jabin at the Brook Kishon,

entries.title: Psalms 83:10
segments: Who perished at En Dor, [Who] became [as] refuse on the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 83:11
segments: Make their nobles like Oreb and like Zeeb, Yes, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,

entries.title: Psalms 83:12
segments: Who said, "Let us take for ourselves The pastures of God for a possession."

entries.title: Psalms 83:13
segments: O my God, make them like the whirling dust, Like the chaff before the wind!

entries.title: Psalms 83:14
segments: As the fire burns the woods, And as the flame sets the mountains on fire,

entries.title: Psalms 83:15
segments: So pursue them with Your tempest, And frighten them with Your storm.

entries.title: Psalms 83:16
segments: Fill their faces with shame, That they may seek Your name, O LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 83:17
segments: Let them be confounded and dismayed forever; Yes, let them be put to shame and perish,

entries.title: Psalms 83:18
segments: That they may know that You, whose name alone [is] the LORD, [Are] the Most High over all the earth.
